notes.title: Version 1.08 Patch Notes
notes.content:
v1.08

- [Cloaking Feather] item added to treasure chests throughout the game and to various Memory Orb vendors. This item causes random enemies on the map to ignore you for one minute.

- [Magical Harp] item added to New Game+.* This item can be used an unlimited amount of time and causes random enemies on the map to ignore you for one minute.
*If you are already in New Game+, simply return to the World Map to receive this item.

- A 'break' of 4 seconds has been added after each battle (both victory and escape), in which random enemies on the map will neither chase you nor notice you.

- Spelling error corrected in the Sewers.

- Passability of rubble in the Mighty Wizard's Castle fixed

notes.title: Strategy Guide Released! And a Thank You.
notes.content:
Hey guys,

We've just released the full 125-page strategy guide for Whisper of a Rose on Steam as a cheap $2.99 DLC! ːwoarmrpurrː Grab it here:

http://store.steampowered.com/app/333410/

It covers a [i]lotta[/i] stuff!
[list][*]A full walkthrough on the main storyline and all side-quests. 
[*]Annotated maps and directions. 
[*]Details and strategies on ALL enemies. 
[*]General tips & tricks. 
[*]A list of all crafting recipes and items. 
[*]An overview of all skill trees. 
[*]The location of all hidden points and secrets in the game. 
[*]Behind-the-scenes information! 
[*]Written by the creator of Whisper of a Rose himself.[/list]

If you already purchased the strategy guide through my website, please e-mail your receipt to admin@roseportalgames.com and I'll get you a key.

Also, I'd like to thank everyone who has been playing & enjoying Whisper of a Rose! This was the first game I ever made, and it has a special place in my heart. It was made over the course of several years while trying to balance my high school studies (yes, I was in high school back then!). I did my best in updating the game & polishing it for its Steam release half a year ago. Because it was my first production, I made some rookie designer mistakes, but it was truly made with joy, passion and dedication. I hope these qualities become apparent while you play the game, and I hope this game touches you in some way.

If you have any thoughts, please feel free to post on the Community Hub (or post a review!) and I'd love to read it and respond.

Thank you again! See you in the dream world! ːwoarchristinaː

Aaron

ːwoarroseː

notes.title: New『Unraveled: Tale of the Shipbreaker's Daughter』!‏
notes.content:
[img]http://www.roseportalgames.com/files/pics/RosePortalGamestransp.png[/img]

[b]Unraveled: Tale of the Shipbreaker's Daughter[/b] is now online! 
Part of the 『Garden of Dreams』 franchise, with Sweet Lily Dreams and Whisper of a Rose.
Click the image below! 

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/696564/unraveled-tale-of-the-shipbreakers-daughter/][img]http://www.roseportalgames.com/files/pics/downloaddemo.png[/img][/url]

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=334926928][img]http://www.roseportalgames.com/files/pics/greenlight.png[/img][/url]


[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/696564/unraveled-tale-of-the-shipbreakers-daughter/][img]http://www.roseportalgames.com/files/pics/NL1_coverbanner.png[/img][/url]

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/696564/unraveled-tale-of-the-shipbreakers-daughter/][img]http://www.roseportalgames.com/files/pics/Brands2b.png[/img][/url]

Please support the project or simply [b]pre-order the game for $10 on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/696564/unraveled-tale-of-the-shipbreakers-daughter/]Kickstarter[/url]![/b] There are lots of extra exclusive goodies you will get!

A few quick points about the game:
[list]  [*][b]Immerse yourself in a moving musical score[/b] hand-crafted by Japanese RPG veteran composers [b]Hiroki Kikuta[/b] and [b]Dale North[/b].[/*]  [*][b]Every scene and every emotion[/b] is shown purely through our beautiful hand-crafted sprites.[/*]  [*][b]Engage in slick, strategic combat[/b] with your monstrously fluffy companion.[/*]  [*][b]Relive your childhood fantasies[/b] as you travel through a little girl's imagination, full of giant sand castles, dragons, magical items, classic puzzles and an 80's themed doll house. [/*]  [*][b]Discover a bit about our world[/b] as the story of Unraveled is based on real events at a ship breaking yard -- inspired by the documentary The Wire Nest![/*][/list]
And if you don't have time to play the game yourself, you can watch this fun Let's Play video! It was made by me! *blushes*

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xMCPkNod40E][img]http://www.roseportalgames.com/files/pics/NL1_vid02.png[/img][/url]

As said before, the music is made by legendary  [b]Hiroki Kikuta[/b]. He has composed for videogames [b]Secret of Mana, Soul Calibur V[/b] and [b]Shining Hearts[/b]. He sees great potential in Unraveled and is happy to work with us! So please [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/696564/unraveled-tale-of-the-shipbreakers-daughter/]support[/url] our project!

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/696564/unraveled-tale-of-the-shipbreakers-daughter/][img]http://www.roseportalgames.com/files/pics/profile_hiroki.png[/img][/url]

[img]http://www.roseportalgames.com/files/pics/690db37906f52e68286b8ffa293bc280_original.png[/img]

We have already been funded for over 25%! That's over 170 pre-order! Thank you so much!!
But we need more to reach that 100%, so please support our project!

Furthermore, I would like to ask everyone reading this to [url=https://www.thunderclap.it/projects/25933-unraveled-on-ks-let-s-go]Thunderclap[/url] us on social media! It would be VERY helpful, even if you can't pre-order or support the project on Kickstarter.

[url=https://www.thunderclap.it/projects/25933-unraveled-on-ks-let-s-go][img]http://www.roseportalgames.com/files/pics/Thunderclap1b.png[/img][/url]

It only takes a second, so if you have Facebook, Twitter or Tumblr, please do.

Thank you! ❤ 
We look forward to hearing from you!

Sincerely,
Aaron & Chancler
Team Unraveled
